input.body: We are writing to request a review of a deduction of $28.40 on order DD-51152, dated 2026-11-07, which was issued with the reason "missing item" for Chicken Thukpa. The order ticket for DD-51152 lists Veg Momo (Steamed) and Samosa Chaat, and it does not list Chicken Thukpa [DD-51152:ticket_omits_item]. The order was ready at 20:26 and was picked up at 20:29, three minutes later, so it was handed to the courier promptly [DD-51152:pickup_handoff]. We understand the ticket shows what was ordered and prepared, and we are not making any claim beyond that. Because the claimed item does not appear on the order ticket, we ask that you review the deduction and reverse it. Thank you for your time and consideration.
